description: Complete visual redesign of the design system (index.css), landing page, login page, dashboard, sidebar/app-layout, and overlays page. Inspired by bettertok.app (clean dashboard, intuitive nav, professional landing with social proof) and tik.tools (dark theme #0a0a0c, cyan/green neon accents #22c55e/#06b6d4, modern professional aesthetic). The redesign should give the site a fresh new look while maintaining all existing functionality.
steps: 1. Update artifacts/creatools/src/index.css: Refresh the CSS custom properties to use a darker base (#0a0a0c background inspired by tik.tools), stronger cyan (#06b6d4) and green (#22c55e) neon accents. Keep purple as secondary. Update the body background gradient to match the new darker aesthetic. Add new utility classes for the neon glow effects.

2. Redesign artifacts/creatools/src/pages/landing.tsx: Complete rewrite of the landing page with a new hero section featuring a gradient heading with cyan/green neon accents, animated background particles/grid, improved feature cards with glassmorphism style, better social proof section, updated pricing section, streamlined CTA. Use #0a0a0c as base background. Make it feel like tik.tools meets bettertok.app - professional, modern, high-conversion.

3. Redesign artifacts/creatools/src/pages/login.tsx: Fresh login/register page with a cleaner split layout, neon accent borders on inputs, smoother transitions, updated gradient buttons using cyan/green palette, improved TikTok handle verification UI. Dark background matching the new design system.

4. Redesign artifacts/creatools/src/pages/dashboard.tsx: New dashboard with clean stat cards (neon borders/glow), quick action grid, improved overlay pills with hover animations, better visual hierarchy, streamlined welcome header with the new color palette. Inspired by bettertok.app's clean and easy-to-use dashboard.

5. Redesign artifacts/creatools/src/components/layout/app-layout.tsx: Modern sidebar with the new color scheme - darker background, cyan active state indicators, cleaner section separators, updated user profile area, improved mobile drawer. Sleek top bar with neon accents. Based on bettertok.app's intuitive navigation.

6. Redesign artifacts/creatools/src/pages/overlays.tsx: Update the overlay studio page with improved preview cards showing real overlay previews (not plain squares), glassmorphism card style, neon accent borders on hover, better categorization and grid layout.
